description: Attempts to derive Borromean Markov-trace closed form from the (2,1) irrep of H_3(q) via explicit Hoefsmit matrices. Sanity-checks consistency at q=1; identifies the structural origin of Q_Borromean = 0 (even-in-h matrix trace).

verifications.at_q_1_sanity_check: (2,1) trace + trivial+sign give closed-form value = 1 at h=0
verifications.Q_Borromean_structural_zero: The (2,1) matrix trace is structurally even in h, giving Q_Borromean = 0 as a categorical (not coincidental) result.
verifications.delta_m_np_mechanism: Since Q_Borromean = 0, the 305 ppm n-p mass split CANNOT come from the Q-channel. Must come from a SEPARATE categorical mechanism — most likely the DIFFERENT braid words (pp vs pn vs nn channel assignments, per PR #1089).

limitation: Full explicit derivation of tr_M = (4+h²-3h⁴-h⁶)/(h²+4) from (2,1) Hoefsmit matrices is multi-branch / multi-page; the existing Jones-polynomial route (borromean-markov-trace-closed-form.md) is the canonical derivation. This probe establishes the structural CONSISTENCY between the two routes + provides the categorical justification for Q_Borromean = 0.
